name: status-dot
title: Status Dot
summary: A small coloured dot that shows the state of something, with or without a word.
use_when: Presence or health next to a name: online, running, failed
Dense lists where a Badge would be too heavy
avoid_when: The state needs words to be understood on its own: use Badge
Something the user can change: use Switch or Chip

props.variant: default | info | success | warning | danger | disabled
props.label: string: the accessible name when there is no visible text
props.pulse: boolean: pulses while something is in progress

copy.text: One word in sentence case: Online, Running, Failed

a11y: Never rely on colour alone: give visible text, or a label when the dot stands alone
The pulse stops under reduced motion
